name: Faculty Management
description: Complete faculty (provider) CRUD operations with points, effort, and service tracking
features: Add new faculty members with ID, name, email
Edit faculty details, rank, effort percentage
Manage bonus points for availability system
View service week counts by type (MICU, APP-ICU, Procedures, Consults)
use_cases: Onboarding new faculty to the system
Adjusting points for fairness in scheduling
api_endpoints: GET /api/admin/faculty - List all faculty with counts
notes: Faculty table serves both Service Weeks and Moonlighting systems
Points system is specific to Service Weeks availability requests
Service counts show current year assignments
Deleting faculty with existing assignments may require reassignment
